title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Judges 12: Jephthah fights Ephraim and the Shibboleth test, then the judges Ibzan, Elon and Abdon.

questions.text: What did the men of Ephraim threaten to do to Jephthah?
questions.explanation: They said, "We will burn your house around you with fire!"

answers.text: Burn his house around him with fire
Drive him back to the land of Tob
Stone him at the city gate

questions.text: What word did the men of Gilead make a fleeing Ephraimite say?
questions.explanation: They said to him, "Now say 'Shibboleth,'" and he said "Sibboleth," for he couldn't pronounce it correctly.

questions.text: Where were the Ephraimites who failed the test seized and killed?
questions.explanation: They seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan.

answers.text: At the fords of the Jordan

questions.text: How many of Ephraim fell at that time?
questions.explanation: At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.

questions.text: How long did Jephthah judge Israel?
questions.explanation: Jephthah judged Israel six years, then died and was buried in the cities of Gilead.

questions.text: Where was the judge Ibzan from?
questions.explanation: After Jephthah, Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

questions.text: What did Ibzan do with his thirty daughters?
questions.explanation: He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons.

answers.text: He gave them to the Levites
He kept them in his own house
He married them to the men of Ephraim
He sent them outside his clan

questions.text: Elon, who judged Israel ten years, belonged to which tribe?
questions.explanation: Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel ten years.
Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

questions.text: On what did Abdon's forty sons and thirty grandsons ride?
questions.explanation: Abdon had forty sons and thirty sons' sons who rode on seventy donkey colts.
